issue: Deploy step uses literal `${build.out_dir}` which will not expand in shell, causing `wrangler pages deploy` to deploy an empty/nonexistent path.
suggestion: Replace with YAML parsing at runtime. Example: `OUT_DIR=$(yq -r '.build.out_dir' app_config.yaml); npx wrangler pages deploy "$OUT_DIR"` and add a canopy check to ensure OUT_DIR exists and is non-empty.

issue: No environment separation (dev/staging/prod) or promotion gates. All steps imply direct-to-prod deploy.
suggestion: Define three environments with guarded promotion: dev → staging → prod. Add wrangler.toml `[env.staging]` and `[env.production]`, Pages projects per env, and CI jobs with environment protection rules. Example deploy: `wrangler pages deploy "$OUT_DIR" --project-name=$CF_PAGES_PROJECT --branch=$GIT_BRANCH` and `wrangler deploy --env production` only after staging smoke/L2 PASS.

issue: G1 (version sync) and G6 (build sync) are commented but not implemented. Canopy currently does not verify the 4-version consistency nor build/deploy alignment.
suggestion: Implement checks: (1) Parse app_config.yaml `.app.version`, package.json `.version`, frontend/src/version.ts export, CLAUDE.md APP_VERSION line; ensure all equal. (2) Parse `.build.out_dir` and verify deploy command uses same path. Fail if mismatch. Use `yq` and `jq` with fallback grep/awk if not installed.

issue: --grep arguments are space-joined strings and wildcards like `design-*` which are not valid Playwright regex patterns; this will not select intended tests.
suggestion: Construct a single regex OR pattern: `PATTERN=$(printf "(%s|" $TESTS | sed 's/|$//'); npx playwright test --grep "$PATTERN"`. Replace `design-*` with `design-.*`. Alternatively tag tests with `@tag` and use `--grep @tag`.

issue: Script assumes `HEAD~1` exists; on initial commits, squash merges, or CI PRs, this fails and yields empty FILES.
suggestion: Detect base commit robustly: `BASE=${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)}`; guard: `git rev-parse --verify "$BASE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || BASE=HEAD~1`; then `git diff --name-only "$BASE"...HEAD`. Add a `--base` CLI arg override.

issue: No rollback strategy or health check with retries; a single `curl | grep version` is brittle and does not validate backend Worker.
suggestion: Add blue/green or last-known-good rollback: keep previous tag artifact; provide `wrangler rollback`/redeploy last Pages build. Verify `/version.json` (frontend) and `/api/health` (Worker) with retry/backoff: 10 tries, exponential backoff, fail CI if not healthy.

issue: Uses hard-coded dev-system path `$HOME/Desktop/dev-system` to compare versions, which breaks in CI/other machines.
suggestion: Standardize dev-system path via env `DEV_SYSTEM_DIR` defaulting to the realpath of the linked canopy script (e.g., `DEV_SYSTEM_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f tests/smoke/canopy_common.sh))/..`). Compare `.dev-system.version` to `$DEV_SYSTEM_DIR/VERSION`.

issue: Scripts lack `set -Eeuo pipefail` and do not trap errors; partial execution can leave inconsistent state.
suggestion: Add `set -Eeuo pipefail` and `trap 'echo ERROR on line $LINENO; exit 1' ERR` to all bash scripts. Quote all variable expansions, check command existence (`command -v jq yq wrangler`), and exit non-zero on failure.

issue: Potentially overwrites existing directories; does not check if APP_DIR exists or is non-empty; symlink creation fails on re-run.
suggestion: Guard: if APP_DIR exists and non-empty, prompt/exit unless `--force`. Use `ln -sfn` for idempotent symlink creation. Add `git init -b main` and `git status` guidance.

issue: Relies on absolute symlink targets; Windows and some CI environments may not support symlinks; no fallback.
suggestion: Detect OS: if `uname -s | grep -qi mingw|msys|cygwin`, copy files instead of symlink; else use `ln -sfn`. Document requirement: `git config core.symlinks true` or provide `--copy` switch.

location: sub_infrastructure.md → 2.6 canopy_common.sh vs 1.2 各アプリ側の構成
issue: Comment states canopy_app.sh minimum 10 lines, but code enforces only 5 active lines.
suggestion: Align rule and check: either reduce documented minimum to 5 lines or change check to `if [ "$APP_LINES" -lt 10 ]`.

issue: Routing ratio sum check (sum to 100) mentioned in app_config_template.yaml comment but not implemented.
suggestion: Add: `if yq -e '.routing.enabled' app_config.yaml >/dev/null 2>&1; then SUM=$(yq '.routing.models.*.ratio' app_config.yaml | awk '{s+=$1}END{print s+0}'); [ "$SUM" -ne 100 ] && echo "FAIL: routing ratio sum=$SUM (must be 100)" && FAIL=1; fi`.

issue: G3 (test count) describes grep-based validation but no source of truth/expected count is defined and canopy implementation is missing.
suggestion: Introduce tests/expected_count.json or derive from `npx playwright test --list --reporter=json` and compare with a baseline committed file. Add canopy check to fail if below expected minus tolerance.

issue: Skip detection flags any `.skip(` including legitimate unconditional skips used for platform gating comments; simple grep may produce false positives.
suggestion: Improve rule: allow `test.skip(() => isPlatform('...'), ...)` or `test.skip(process.env.CI...)` via regex whitelist; or parse AST via `eslint` custom rule. At minimum, only fail on `test.skip(` without 'platform' or allowed tokens AND not in comment.

issue: AT detection uses `^AT-[0-9]` which may miss the documented `AT-N:` template; also bash command detection scans whole block, not specifically the 完了コマンド section, causing false positives.
suggestion: Adjust regex to `^AT-` or `^AT-[0-9]+:`; restrict bash command presence to the '完了コマンド' block via extracting lines between '完了コマンド:' and next blank/heading. Add `if [ ! -f "$SP" ]; then echo 'ERROR: session_progress not found'; exit 1; fi`.

issue: Does not ensure archive directory exists; no backup copy before in-place modification; fails hard if '## 完了済み' missing.
suggestion: Add `mkdir -p $(dirname "$ARCHIVE")`; create backup `cp "$SP" "$SP.bak.$(date +%s)"`; if '完了済み' missing and lines > MAX, move oldest missions (by heading) to archive with a fallback strategy instead of immediate exit.

issue: No CI/CD pipeline definition (e.g., GitHub Actions/Cloudflare Pages build) though full automation is a core principle.
suggestion: Provide a `ci/cd` template (yaml) with jobs: build (cache node_modules), canopy, L1, L2, deploy-staging, manual-approval, deploy-prod, tag-and-release. Upload Playwright HTML report and screenshots as artifacts and attach to session results.

issue: Copies development_rules_common.md into app root then also runs build_rules.sh to generate a merged file, leaving redundant common file in app repo.
suggestion: Do not copy `development_rules_common.md` to app repo. Instead read directly from dev-system path in `build_rules.sh`. Remove the `cp "$DEV_SYSTEM/rules/development_rules_common.md" .` line.

issue: Version sync relies on a `frontend/src/version.ts` convention that is not included in the templates and may be absent in non-frontend apps.
suggestion: Add a version source template file (e.g., templates/frontend/src/version.ts) and in canopy make the path configurable via app_config.yaml (e.g., `.version.file`). If missing, canopy should fail with actionable message.

issue: Missing configuration for wrangler environments, project names, account IDs, and KV namespace IDs/secrets.
suggestion: Augment template with: `cloudflare: { account_id, pages_project_dev, pages_project_staging, pages_project_prod, worker_name, kv_namespaces: { TOKEN_KV: { dev, staging, prod } } }`. Add canopy checks to validate presence before deploy.

issue: No dependency checks for required CLI tools (wrangler, yq, jq, node/npm).
suggestion: Add preflight: for cmd in jq yq wrangler node npm; do command -v $cmd >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL: $cmd not installed"; FAIL=1; }; done.

issue: If no affected tests mapped, script falls back to `--grep "smoke"` assuming titles contain 'smoke'; not standardized.
suggestion: Standardize smoke tag naming (`@smoke`) and use `--grep "@smoke"`. Add mapping file `tests/affected-map.yaml` to decouple mappings from script and make ADV-owned.

location: dev_system_spec.md → §5 ミッション定義テンプレート
issue: No instruction to persist and publish Playwright reports/screenshots for PO visual verification in automation context.
suggestion: Augment completion commands to include `--reporter=html,json` and archive `playwright-report` and `test-results` to `instructions/results/` with timestamp; update canopy to confirm artifact presence.

issue: Deployment flow details are split between main spec and scripts without a single authoritative script; main spec lists steps but automation code is not centralized.
suggestion: Create a single `scripts/deploy_c2.sh` (in dev-system) implementing the full §8 flow with guards and environment orchestration; reference it from main spec and link it into apps. Keep main spec high-level to avoid drift.

location: dev_system_spec.md → §10.2 バージョンpin方式 / sub_infrastructure.md → 2.6 canopy_common.sh
issue: Stated rule: mismatch is WARN for 3 sessions then FAIL, but canopy implementation doesn’t track sessions nor escalate WARN→FAIL.
suggestion: Write a state file `instructions/results/canopy_version_mismatch.count` incremented on WARN; once >=3, convert to FAIL and reset on match. Or require update before deploy (C2) and fail in C2 context.

issue: L1/L2 time budgets (2 min/5-10 min) are declared but not enforced; long-running tests can break pipeline SLAs.
suggestion: Enforce with Playwright `--timeout` and job-level `timeout-minutes` in CI; canopy can parse duration from test JSON and warn/fail if exceeding budgets.

issue: `git tag vX.Y.Z` in CI may silently fail to push; tags are not propagated to remote.
suggestion: After creating the tag, run `git push origin "v$VERSION"` and optionally create a GitHub Release with changelog generated from commits/session logs.

issue: Reference path check flags any '参照:' line without a slash, but 'フルパス' definition is unclear (repo-root absolute vs relative).
suggestion: Define rule: references must be repo-root relative (e.g., `docs/xyz.md`). Update linter to enforce `^参照:\s+(docs/|tests/|src/)` and fail otherwise.

location: sub_system_map.md → §3 データフロー / dev_system_spec.md → §11
issue: No validation ensuring TOKEN_KV binding exists in Worker envs; tests rely on KV but no preflight check.
suggestion: Add canopy preflight using `wrangler kv namespace list | jq` to verify TOKEN_KV binding presence for the target env; fail if missing. Document required binding names in app_config.yaml.

issue: Shebangs use `#!/bin/bash`, which may not exist on all systems (e.g., some distros/macOS use /usr/local/bin/bash or default to zsh).
suggestion: Switch to `#!/usr/bin/env bash` for portability.
